identity.title: Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Limited Edition Collection

leadText:
The Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Limited Edition Collection is a Region 4 DVD set that was released by in Australia on October 1, 2015. This DVD set is also referred to as the Pokémon Black & White Collector's Set in promotional material. It contains four individual DVD cases with uniform covers that each contain a number of discs. Overall, the set includes 18 discs with 142 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6367. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

It contains all of the dubbed episodes from Pokémon the Series: Black & White. Specifically, it has episodes from Black & White, Rival Destinies, and Adventures in Unova and Beyond.

It contains all of the dubbed episodes from Pokémon the Series: Black & White. Specifically, it has episodes from Black & White, Rival Destinies, and Adventures in Unova and Beyond.

==Contents==
===Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Part 1===
 
Part 1 contains all the episodes from Black & White across six discs.
 
 
===Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Part 2===
 
Part 2 contains all the episodes from Rival Destinies across six discs.
 
 
===Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Part 3===
 
Part 3 contains all the episodes from the Adventures in Unova portion of sixteenth season across three discs. This has the same episodes as .
 
 
===Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Part 4===
 
Part 4 contains all the episodes from the Adventures in Unova and Beyond portion of sixteenth season across three discs. This has the same episodes as .
